result.title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
result.summary: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向交互式长视频生成，为冻结的自回归扩散生成器构建对象级 KV 记忆：保留被跟踪对象区域的原始 KV、按注意力分数挑选背景 KV，并附上源场景与外观记录，由 LLM 选择所需记录后整合生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对象区域 KV + 注意力分数筛选 + LLM 选记录」的选择性检索机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、以及 KV 缓存结构如何影响 latent 相似度提供可核查的方法线索，但任务目标为视频生成，检索的因果作用需读原文确认。
